stories.title: Chinese Hackers Use AI-Powered ARTEX to Target Over 200 Organizations Worldwide
stories.why: A China-linked group called Vapor Panda has used the ARTEX AI pentesting framework against more than 200 organizations since 17 October.

stories.title: Linux Kernel TCP Flaw With 9.8 CVSS Score Affects Ubuntu, Red Hat and Other Distributions
stories.why: CVE-2026-98432 has no fixed Ubuntu or RHEL kernel yet, and Anthropic says its AI wrote a working root exploit for it.

stories.title: 26,400 Valid Cloud and AI Credentials Found Exposed in Public Gitee Repositories
stories.why: Thousands of still-working cloud and AI API keys sit in public code repositories, with no confirmed revocation.

stories.title: Anthropic's Unreleased AI Model Chains Flaws Into Working Chrome, Safari, Windows and Linux Exploits
stories.why: An unreleased model found separate flaws across major platforms and chained them into working exploits. All of them are now patched.

stories.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon Leads Benchmarks for Finding, Exploiting, and Patching Vulnerabilities
stories.why: Google's new model posts top scores on benchmarks for vulnerability discovery, exploitation and patching.

stories.title: Bitdefender's new tool maps how attackers could reach critical systems
stories.why: GravityZone Exposure Management finds flaws, misconfigurations and risky user behaviour, then maps the attack paths that chain them together.

stories.title: NIK C2 Malware Can Use Victims' OpenAI Keys for AI Queries
stories.why: New malware runs its AI queries on its victims' own OpenAI keys, so leaked AI credentials become attacker infrastructure.

stories.title: Cybersecurity M&A Roundup: Proofpoint Agrees $6.3bn Varonis Acquisition
stories.why: Proofpoint is buying Varonis to strengthen its AI security offering, one of several AI-driven security deals in October.

stories.title: Fake ChatGPT and Claude Apps Abuse Signed Executables to Deploy Crypto Miners
stories.why: The Yoba campaign plants a loader next to genuine signed OpenAI and Anthropic executables in fake AI desktop apps on GitHub.

stories.title: AI Didn't Break Vulnerability Management: it Exposed its Biggest Weakness
stories.why: An opinion piece arguing that AI-speed exploitation shows why teams must prioritise by real exposure instead of patch counts.
